content:
200
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully retrieved the details for the specified child
account.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string <uuid>
The UUID of the customer account in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
string
The name of the customer account in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
account_uuid
required
uuid
required
container_name
string
The customer's licensing management system customer ID.
string
A custom name in addition to the container name to help you
more easily identify the customer / container.
string
The sso_username.
string
The Tenable AWS cloud region that contains the customer
account. Customer account regions correspond to the regions
used for cloud sensors. To avoid latency issues, Tenable
recommends that scans in the customer instance use scanners in
the same region as the customer account.
integer <int64>
The number of assets currently counted against the customer's
license.
integer <int64>
The number of assets which the customer is licensed to scan.
number
decimal places <= 1
The current license utilization.
Array of strings (Licensed-Apps)
An array of strings defining the list of licensed Tenable
applications For example, ["vm", "was", "lumin"] . Valid
strings include the following:
ad—Tenable Identity Exposure
asm—Tenable Attack Surface Management
lumin—Tenable Lumin
one—Tenable One
vm—Tenable Vulnerability Management
was—Tenable Web App Scanning
string
User-defined text; for example, internal tracking or customer
contact information.
lms_customer_id
custom_name
sso_username
region
licensed_assets
licensed_assets_limit
license_utilization
licensed_apps
notes
string
The UUID of the logo assigned to the customer account in the
Tenable MSSP Portal. This attribute is only present if a custom
logo is assigned to the account.
Array of strings
A list of the customer domains.
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the
container was created; for example, 2021-01-16T12:00:00Z .
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the
container was last modified; for example, 2021-01-
16T12:00:00Z .
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified child account.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
